messages.text: Just checking to see if my t40 is still scheduled to ship on the 20th?

Raland, I can't confirm the 20th. That date isn't on your order (Shop····) and I don't have it anywhere else.

Here's what I do know. Magic M. expects to ship the 40T units out of their factory on November 12. All 300 units go out together. Your 40T, the Miner D. and the Power K. will ship to you in the same box. We email you the tracking as soon as it leaves for (address hidden).

I'm sorry the dates on this one have kept changing. That's on us.
